title: Weight-Dictionary Decomposition: code, results and per-token records
description: Scripts, result files, run logs and per-token records behind the paper Weight-Dictionary Decomposition: Reading a Transformer's Residual Stream with Its Own Writes (preprint, September 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22749478). Every number in the paper is written by a named script into results/, with the run log in logs/. Code under MIT; result files, logs and per-token records under CC BY 4.0.
